body:
`eda-flowtune` (track 7, milestone 3, first half): all 400 ABC pass sequences (length 0 to 3) on eight small SKY130-mapped designs, so every optimum is known. Result is mostly negative: one design's best recipe scores a mean 1.31x another's optimum, a leave-one-out consensus recipe is only slightly better than a median sequence, and a transferred warm start helps one design only. Stylised; no place and route. OpenROAD-settings half not done (OpenROAD not installed). 11 tests, `site/build.py` ok, results from `experiments/results.txt`.
